name: Hornero Base Converter
description: Utility Tools 2.0 base converter: bar quick action (decimal or 0x hex) and compact dashboard detail converting decimal integers to binary/octal/hex and hex back. Invalid digits show errors.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard base converter: decimal to binary/octal/hex and hex back to decimal.

uppercaseHex.description: Show hexadecimal output in uppercase (the 1.x behaviour).
